subject: Volunteering Opportunities with Cat Coalition
content:
Dear Cat Coalition Team,


My name is Johanna Parra, and I am the current Community Service Chair for the National Latinx Psychology Association at the University of Texas at Arlington. I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself and reach out on behalf of our organization.


Our members are passionate about serving our campus and local community, and we are always looking for meaningful ways to get involved. I wanted to ask if UTA Campus Cat Coalition has any upcoming volunteer opportunities that our members could participate in. Additionally, if your department ever needs extra support, I would be happy to coordinate volunteers from our organization to assist with your events or initiatives.


Thank you for the important work your team does for UTA. I look forward to the possibility of collaborating and supporting your efforts.


Warm regards,

Johanna Parra

Community Service Chair

National Latinx Psychology Association

University of Texas at Arlington

subject: Connecting and Collaborating with Mi Familia en Accion!
content:
My name is Jailene, and I’m with *Mi Familia en Accion (MFA)*, a civic
engagement and leadership organization that partners with student groups to
build advocacy and organizing skills.

I was excited to learn about the work Campus Cat Coalition is doing to care
for the cats on campus and engage students in hands-on community action.
The work you’re already leading has natural connections to
advocacy—organizing volunteers, mobilizing resources, and raising awareness
are all core skills of leadership that MFA helps students strengthen.

We’d love to connect with your group to explore how MFA can help amplify
your efforts, bring visibility to the work you’re doing, and offer tools
that could make your organizing even more effective. Whether that’s through
leadership workshops, tabling together, or collaboration on awareness
events, we’d be excited to support your mission while creating pathways for
your members to grow as advocates.

Would you be open to a quick 1:1 (in-person or virtual) to brainstorm
possibilities?

Looking forward to connecting,

Best Regards,
Jailene Salvador
Dallas Program Organizer
Mi Familia Vota
(C) 469.664.9010
Based in: Dallas, Texas

content:
Good morning!

Over at the Dan Dipert University Welcome Center at UTA, we are hiring for new Trailblazer student tour guides! Attached is our flyer and below is a short description of the position:


  *   Trailblazer Tour Guides lead walking campus tours for prospective students, families, school/community groups, and VIP guests. Tour Guides staff the Dan Dipert University Welcome Center in the College Park District and help host University recruitment events. The primary function is to serve as representatives of the University of Texas at Arlington and create memorable experiences for campus guests.

We would greatly appreciate if you could help spread the word about our position by sharing it with your organization and platforms! Our job application can be found on Handshake<https://uta.joinhandshake.com/login> at job number 10024312, or by scanning the QR code on the attached flyer.

subject: Collaboration Opportunity Proposal (RLC Student Volunteers)
content:
Dear Campus Cat Coalition team,
My name is Shriya, and I’m serving as a Residential Peer Mentor (RPM) for the Engineering Residential Learning Community. I have been aware of your work for the campus cats and would like to share what you do with the students in my RLC through a service event. I see this as a great introduction for the RLC students to the Campus Cat Coalition, potentially encouraging some of them to get more involved with your organization in the future.
Since student turnout can vary, I would appreciate your suggestions for activities that could work well for both a smaller group and a larger group. Some possibilities that come to mind include helping with feeding the cats, supporting a donation or supply drive, or assisting with setting up/maintaining cat shelters—but we’re very open to whatever would be most useful to your team.
For scheduling, I’m generally free on Thursday evenings (preferred), but I’m also available after 7:30 pm on Wednesdays. Please let me know if there’s a day or time that would work best on your end.
My RLC students are excited to support your mission. Looking forward to hearing your thoughts and hopefully collaborating soon!
Warm regards,
Shriya Gurjar
Residential Peer Mentor, Engineering RLC

Hey CampusCats,

Here's what you need to know

Automatic conversion: No action is required from you. On August 27, your existing operations balance will be automatically converted to credits at a 1:1 rate: 1 Operation = 1 Credit.

( https://www.make.com/en?utm_campaign=credits-launch-1308&utm_medium=email&utm_source=customer.io )
Hey CampusCats,

 

We’re writing to let you know about an important billing update.

 

Starting August 27, 2025, operations will be replaced by credits as the new billing unit. Most actions will consume 1 credit per action, advanced features (especially AI) consume more, either with a fixed cost or based on usage, providing a pricing model that better reflects your specific usage.

Here's what you need to know

Automatic conversion: No action is required from you. On August 27, your existing operations balance will be automatically converted to credits at a 1:1 rate: 1 Operation = 1 Credit.

Plan and price: Your current plan and price stay exactly the same. Both manual and automatic purchases of extra credits will work the same way as before.

Credit consumption: Most actions will consume 1 credit per action, advanced features (especially AI) consume more, either with a fixed cost or based on usage.

While operations will no longer be a billing unit, they will still be visible within your scenario execution, now representing your data unit processed.

subject: Collaboration Opportunity Proposal (RLC Student Volunteers)
content:
Dear Campus Cat Coalition team,
My name is Shriya, and I’m serving as a Residential Peer Mentor (RPM) for the Engineering Residential Learning Community. I have been aware of your work for the campus cats and would like to share what you do with the students in my RLC through a service event. I see this as a great introduction for the RLC students to the Campus Cat Coalition, potentially encouraging some of them to get more involved with your organization in the future.
Since student turnout can vary, I would appreciate your suggestions for activities that could work well for both a smaller group and a larger group. Some possibilities that come to mind include helping with feeding the cats, supporting a donation or supply drive, or assisting with setting up/maintaining cat shelters—but we’re very open to whatever would be most useful to your team.
For scheduling, I’m generally free on Thursday evenings (preferred), but I’m also available after 7:30 pm on Wednesdays. Please let me know if there’s a day or time that would work best on your end.
My RLC students are excited to support your mission. Looking forward to hearing your thoughts and hopefully collaborating soon!
Warm regards,
Shriya Gurjar
Residential Peer Mentor, Engineering RLC

Automatic conversion: No action is required from you. On August 27, your existing operations balance will be automatically converted to credits at a 1:1 rate: 1 Operation = 1 Credit.

Plan and price: Your current plan and price stay exactly the same. Manual and automatic purchases of extra credits will work the same way as before.

subject: Volunteering Opportunities with Cat Coalition
content:
Dear Cat Coalition Team,


My name is Johanna Parra, and I am the current Community Service Chair for the National Latinx Psychology Association at the University of Texas at Arlington. I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself and reach out on behalf of our organization.


Our members are passionate about serving our campus and local community, and we are always looking for meaningful ways to get involved. I wanted to ask if UTA Campus Cat Coalition has any upcoming volunteer opportunities that our members could participate in. Additionally, if your department ever needs extra support, I would be happy to coordinate volunteers from our organization to assist with your events or initiatives.


Thank you for the important work your team does for UTA. I look forward to the possibility of collaborating and supporting your efforts.


Warm regards,

Johanna Parra

Community Service Chair

National Latinx Psychology Association

University of Texas at Arlington

subject: Connecting and Collaborating with Mi Familia en Accion!
content:
My name is Jailene, and I’m with *Mi Familia en Accion (MFA)*, a civic
engagement and leadership organization that partners with student groups to
build advocacy and organizing skills.

I was excited to learn about the work Campus Cat Coalition is doing to care
for the cats on campus and engage students in hands-on community action.
The work you’re already leading has natural connections to
advocacy—organizing volunteers, mobilizing resources, and raising awareness
are all core skills of leadership that MFA helps students strengthen.

We’d love to connect with your group to explore how MFA can help amplify
your efforts, bring visibility to the work you’re doing, and offer tools
that could make your organizing even more effective. Whether that’s through
leadership workshops, tabling together, or collaboration on awareness
events, we’d be excited to support your mission while creating pathways for
your members to grow as advocates.

Would you be open to a quick 1:1 (in-person or virtual) to brainstorm
possibilities?

subject: Does she have a home? Young adult cat.
content:
Hello!
My husband works at the university and told me to contact the UTA cat
coalition. My name is Christina Andrews, my husband is Evin Carsey.

her....

Please let me know what can be done! Thank you!

content:
( https://www.make.com/en?utm_campaign=credits-launch-1308&utm_medium=email&utm_source=customer.io )
Hey CampusCats,

 

We’re writing to let you know about an important billing update.

 

Starting August 27, 2025, operations will be replaced by credits as the new billing unit. Most actions will consume 1 credit per action, advanced features (especially AI) consume more, either with a fixed cost or based on usage, providing a pricing model that better reflects your specific usage.

Here's what you need to know

Automatic conversion: No action is required from you. On August 27, your existing operations balance will be automatically converted to credits at a 1:1 rate: 1 Operation = 1 Credit.

Plan and price: Your current plan and price stay exactly the same. Both manual and automatic purchases of extra credits will work the same way as before.

Credit consumption: Most actions will consume 1 credit per action, advanced features (especially AI) consume more, either with a fixed cost or based on usage.

While operations will no longer be a billing unit, they will still be visible within your scenario execution, now representing your data unit processed. 

 

For more information about this change and how credits work, please visit our help documentation ( https://help.make.com/credits?utm_campaign=credits-launch-1308&utm_medium=email&utm_source=customer.io ). If you have any questions, don't hesitate to reach

subject: Trailblazer Tour Guide Hiring
content:
Good morning!

Over at the Dan Dipert University Welcome Center at UTA, we are hiring for new Trailblazer student tour guides! Attached is our flyer and below is a short description of the position:


  *   Trailblazer Tour Guides lead walking campus tours for prospective students, families, school/community groups, and VIP guests. Tour Guides staff the Dan Dipert University Welcome Center in the College Park District and help host University recruitment events. The primary function is to serve as representatives of the University of Texas at Arlington and create memorable experiences for campus guests.


  *   Being a tour guide is a great opportunity to refine your public speaking and leadership skills, as well as benefit from a wide variety of professional development and teambuilding opportunities that our program provides!



We would greatly appreciate if you could help spread the word about our position by sharing it with your organization and platforms! Our job application can be found on Handshake<https://uta.joinhandshake.com/login> at job number 10024312, or by scanning the QR code on the attached flyer.

Please let me know if you have any questions about the position. I'm happy to provide any other information you might need!

MARK REEDER, M.A. (he/him/his)
Program Assistant Director, Recruitment Events
